in_sanskrit.name: Devnath
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The compound name 'Devnath' is derived from 'Deva' and 'Nath'. 'Deva' is a Sanskrit word meaning 'god'. 'Nath' is a Sanskrit word meaning 'lord' or 'master'. Thus, 'Devnath' means 'god of lords' or 'lord of gods'.

in_hindi.name: Devnāth
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name 'Devnāth' is a transliteration of the Sanskrit compound name 'Devnath'. 'Dev' (देव) is a Hindi word meaning 'god', and 'nāth' (नाथ) is a Hindi word meaning 'lord' or 'master'. Thus, 'Devnāth' means 'god of lords' or 'lord of gods'.

in_tamil.name: Thevanaathiru
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name 'Thevanaathiru' is a transliteration of the Sanskrit compound name 'Devnath'. 'Thevam' (தேவம்) is a Tamil word meaning 'god', and 'nāthiru' (நாதிரு) is a Tamil word meaning 'lord' or 'master'. Thus, 'Thevanaathiru' means 'god of lords' or 'lord of gods'.

in_telugu.name: Devanātha
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name 'Devanātha' is a transliteration of the Sanskrit compound name 'Devnath'. 'Devu' (దేవు) is a Telugu word meaning 'god', and 'nātha' (నాథ) is a Telugu word meaning 'lord' or 'master'. Thus, 'Devanātha' means 'god of lords' or 'lord of gods'.

in_marathi.name: Devnath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Devnath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Devnath is a combination of two words – ‘Dev’ meaning god and ‘Nath’ meaning lord or master. In Hindu mythology, Devnath refers to Lord Shiva, who is considered the god of gods and the lord of the universe.
